title: Best Next Step Versus Most Likely Diagnosis Questions
subject: MCQ Hacks
preview: Most likely diagnosis asks for the best explanation of the evidence; best next step asks for the immediate decision under the circumstances.
quickRevision: Most likely diagnosis asks for the best explanation of the evidence; best next step asks for the immediate decision under the circumstances.
Immediate stabilization and definitive treatment are different phases of care.
Look for words such as first, next, initial and most appropriate to set the response priority.

sections.title: Recognize the question type
points: Most likely diagnosis asks for the best explanation of the evidence; best next step asks for the immediate decision under the circumstances.
A stable patient may need testing, while an unstable patient may need resuscitation before definitive diagnostics.

sections.title: Use this in timed practice
points: Immediate stabilization and definitive treatment are different phases of care.
Look for words such as first, next, initial and most appropriate to set the response priority.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not choose the definitive procedure when an airway or circulatory emergency takes priority.

quiz.question: What does best next step primarily test?
quiz.explanation: Priority of action in context. Look for words such as first, next, initial and most appropriate to set the response priority.
